## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `--exclude` flag should be fixed because it does not take its default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE`, which the project's CLI-flag rule requires for every new flag under `cli/`.

## Changes
This pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag to the archive CLI. `collect` now skips files whose basenames match any of the patterns and logs each skipped path. The change also documents the flag in `docs/flags.md` and adds unit and end-to-end tests, plus a one-line text fixture.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` env var — When CI sets `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and runs `archive src`, nothing is excluded, because the flag's default is a hard-coded `[]`. This breaks `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11`: "Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable". — CI pipelines that set options through the environment silently archive files they meant to exclude. — Fix: Build the default from `os.environ.get("ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE")`, choosing a separator for multiple globs, and add a test next to `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing`.
